limits: Receive time includes readiness wait, transport and reduction; no per-peer wait statistics were collected.
Same graph16 is slow at B16 too, so inactive padding rows alone do not explain the cliff.
Profiler client timings are excluded from the prior unprofiled throughput benchmark.
No claim is made about hardware MFU/MBU or measured RDMA bandwidth from these time categories.

method.bucket_evidence: predicted from saved args and source, no new trace

tps_gpu_curve.x_definition: 1000 / saved TPOT P50 in milliseconds; current and optimized use the mean of three round P50 values
tps_gpu_curve.y_definition: total output tokens/s / 16 decode GPUs; prefill GPUs are not included
tps_gpu_curve.right_y_definition: k output tokens per GPU minute = left_y * 0.06
method_notes: The README reference is Kimi K2.5/B200; only its axes/layout are borrowed, no reference performance data is overlaid.
Historical tests use 129900 input / 1024 output and one round with uneven rank distribution; current and optimized use 128928 / 2048 and three rounds.
Historical saved TPOT is rounded to 0.1 ms, limiting the precision of recomputed TPS.
Lines connect saved observations sorted by TPS, with no curve fitting, extrapolation, or proof of cross-configuration Pareto dominance.
B is nominal total concurrency / 16; current B4-B64 have verified actual rank loads, and B128 has peak 64 running plus 64 waiting per rank.
